definitions.name: todo
definitions.label: Todo
definitions.description: Plan and track your own next steps for this request; start the list yourself, without being asked, before the first edit of multi-step work. A change's tasks are in `jhon status`: never copy them here. Actions: write (whole list), update, add, clear, list.
promptGuidelines: Use todo for three or more steps or a list the user hands you; skip trivial requests. A small change keeps no list.
Keep exactly one task in_progress; mark it done right after it is verified, never while tests fail or the work is partial (add a task for the blocker).
When the plan changes, write the complete list and keep ids of existing tasks; mark obsolete tasks dropped, never done.

Mark a task blocked with a note naming what it waits for only when that is outside the list (a person, an authorization); a prerequisite in the list keeps it pending. Back to pending once the condition holds.

action.description: write replaces the whole list; add appends one task; update changes one task by id; clear empties the list; list reports it.

tasks.description: For write: the complete ordered list. Keep the id of tasks that already exist so their history survives; omit it for new ones.

title.description: Short imperative title, e.g. 'Write the parser'.

status.description: Defaults to pending. blocked: open but waiting on something outside the list; dropped: will not be done, on purpose.

note.description: What is happening right now, shown while in_progress, e.g. 'writing tests'; required for blocked, naming what it waits for, e.g. 'waiting for an admin'.

title.description: Title for add, or a new title for update.

note.description: Note for add or update; required for blocked.
